title: SQRT of zero, of a negative number, of an integer, of a subnormal and of a large REAL
note: SQRT of a REAL: the root for a positive number (to within a part in 10^7), 0.0 for 0.0 and for a negative number (a value IEC 61131-3 leaves undefined), an integer argument is converted to REAL; 1.0E-40 is a subnormal REAL and its root is 1.0E-20; a NaN has the root NaN
